title: Knot your average qutrit: Measurement-induced entanglement splitting and the cabling dictionary for GHZ and W States
summary: Multipartite entanglement is conventionally classified by state families viz. family of GHZ and W class of states, with each family expected to behave differently under measurement. We show that, at least for the question of how entanglement splits after a single-particle measurement, this is not the division that matters for qutrits.
